summary: FlowVolta is building the next generation of clean energy systems, founded in 2025. Type: startup / scale-up. About 5 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Tiny Rotterdam cleantech start-up founded in 2025, building modular electrolysers for cheaper hydrogen; mostly engineering and research internships.

culture.text: A team of about 5 people, founded in 2025 by hydrogen-industry specialists, led by founders Saeid Khalafvand (CEO) and Stefano de Cillis (CPO).
People studied at TU Delft, Isfahan University of Technology, Hanze and Nanyang Technological University, mostly mechanical and energy engineering.
Past internships covered CFD and multiphysics simulation, mechanical design and cost modelling of electrochemical systems.

open.text: Not an IND recognised visa sponsor, so non-EU graduates may struggle to get a work visa here.
All 3 current jobs here (2 internships, 1 entry-level role in Rotterdam) don't require Dutch.
The founding team itself is international.

growth.text: Founded in 2025 and still very small at about 5 employees; its careers page says it is growing.
